package.name: wojtek_targeting
package.description:
The targeting gimbal of the wojtek_targeting experiment: a DynamixelSDK driver for the XM540 pan / XM430 tilt pair behind a U2D2, and the controller that turns detections into bounded pan/tilt commands.
This package is the only thing that commands those two servos. It has no laser control in it, by design: the laser is armed by hardware outside this graph.
Nothing here touches the walking stack -- not ros2_control, not the MD80 interface, not the 400 Hz loop, not arming.
